instruction: Query the OQMD database to count all binary compounds containing Al (element_set=Al AND ntypes=2), and save the total count to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_6.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
